title: CW 1722 Corn (Cornworld 1722): Yield, Maturity and Characteristics
metaTitle: CW 1722 Corn: Yield, Maturity and Characteristics
metaDescription: CW 1722 corn is a yellow hybrid corn variety for Luzon and Mindanao. 104 to 110 days to harvest, 8.9 t/ha in trials. See its ratings and traits.
excerpt: CW 1722 corn is a yellow hybrid corn variety, also sold or known as Cornworld 1722. It was registered with the National Seed Industry Council in 2023 as NSIC 2023 Cn 336. Cornworld Breeding Systems bred it. It takes 104 to 110 days from planting to the harvest of dry grain, with 8.9 tonnes per hectare in the trials (9.14 in Luzon, 8.66 in Mindanao).

blocks.text: If you came here looking for Cornworld 1722, this is the same corn. Its seller and farm sources add notes, listed at the end. Compare it with the others in our [corn variety finder](/crop-varieties/corn), or see [every crop variety](/crop-varieties) we list. items: **Days to harvest:** 104 to 110 days from planting to the harvest of dry grain.
**Yield:** 8.9 tonnes per hectare in the trials (9.14 in Luzon, 8.66 in Mindanao).

blocks.text: How long does it take, and how much does it yield?

CW 1722 corn takes 104 to 110 days from planting to the harvest of dry grain. That is 3.1 days longer than the average of the 215 yellow hybrid corn varieties with a day count, 103.6 days. A shorter crop frees the field sooner and dodges more of the weather, while a longer one often fills more.

Its average yield of 8.9 t/ha beats the average of its group, 7.17. It sits in the top quarter of its group. One tonne of shelled corn fills about 20 sacks of 50 kilograms. Trial yields come from well managed plots, so your own will depend on water, fertilizer, pests and timing. Its seller gives 104 to 110 in national trials.

Once you know the day count, anee.io dates every task from each lot's own planting day, with [the growth stages and weather](/features/growth-stages-and-weather) beside it.
Is it resistant to pests and diseases?

blocks.caption: Reactions in trials, rated under natural field conditions

blocks.text: It showed no weak spot in the ratings on record. Still, a resistant variety can break down when a new strain or pest population comes, so keep scouting. Read up on [Asian corn borer](/pests/asian-corn-borer).

The pests and diseases that hit corn fields most often: [Asian corn borer](/pests/asian-corn-borer), [banded leaf and sheath blight](/diseases/banded-leaf-and-sheath-blight), [Corn downy mildew](/diseases/corn-downy-mildew), [Corn ear rot](/diseases/corn-ear-rot), [Corn earworm](/pests/corn-earworm). Our [pest finder](/pests) and [disease finder](/diseases) help you name what you see.
Its ears grew about 16.59 cm long in the trials. The shelling recovery was 78.5 percent, the share of the ear weight that comes off as grain. A higher share means more grain from every sack of ears.

blocks.text: Why farmers know it: one of Cornworld's newest registered conventional hybrids, Cornworld enters DA Bicol derbies. Check these against what farmers near you have seen, because the same variety can do differently from one town to the next.
Where and when to plant CW 1722 corn

It is recommended for Luzon and Mindanao. Start with the color your buyer pays for: yellow corn goes to feed mills, while white and glutinous corn go to the table. Next, pick between a hybrid, which yields more but needs new seed every season, and an open pollinated variety, whose seed you can save. Then match the island group in its recommendation, because trials in Luzon and Mindanao give different winners. Before planting, get the field ready with our guide: [Land preparation for corn](/land-preparation/corn-land-preparation).

items.q: Is Cornworld 1722 the same as CW 1722?
items.a: Yes. Cornworld 1722 is another name for CW 1722, registered as NSIC 2023 Cn 336. Seed sellers use both, so ask for either one.

items.q: How long does it take to harvest?
items.a: It takes 104 to 110 days from planting to the harvest of dry grain. Then the weather and your care decide the exact day.
The record shows 8.9 tonnes per hectare in the trials (9.14 in Luzon, 8.66 in Mindanao). Your own yield depends on the soil, water, fertilizer and pests on your farm.
No. It is a hybrid, so seed saved from it does not grow true and yields less. Buy new seed each season.
It is recommended for Luzon and Mindanao. Ask your municipal agriculturist how it has done in your town.

items.q: Where can I buy seed of CW 1722?
items.a: Ask an accredited seed dealer in your province, the seller named on this page or your municipal agriculturist. Look for the certified seed tag or a sealed pack before you pay.
